Listen to “Rabba Ishq Na Hove” from the 2003 Bollywood film Andaaz, featuring Akshay Kumar, Lara Dutta, and Priyanka Chopra. With vocals by Alka Yagnik, Kailash Kher, Sapna Mukherjee, and Sonu Nigam, this emotional Hindi film song captures the intensity of love, longing, and heartbreak.
